en.Essa pedra é o peixe mais venenoso do mu: This rock is the most venomous fish in the world, and you can step on it without seeing it. And the first aid is really weird.
en.É o peixe-pedra. Ele fica parado no fund: It's the stonefish. It sits still on the shallow sea floor, covered in algae, looking exactly like a rock.
en.Nas costas ele tem treze espinhos. Quand: It has thirteen spines on its back. When someone steps on it, they inject venom straight into the foot.
en.A dor é descrita como uma das piores que: The pain is described as one of the worst there is, and the foot swells up fast.
en.E o socorro estranho? Água bem quente, s: And the weird first aid? Very hot water, without burning, because heat breaks down the venom. And there's even an antivenom.
en.Comenta: você já pisou em alguma coisa n: Comment: have you ever stepped on something in the sea? And follow Maia, there's one of these every day!
